name: Phone stand
blurb: A desk stand that holds a phone up so you can watch or video-call.

steps.text: Cut the base and the back from the 1x4, and the lip from the 1x2.
Glue the lip along the front edge of the base and clamp it.
Mark two holes 3/8 inch from the back end of the base and drill them through; countersink them underneath.
Stand the back in place and drill small pilot holes up into it through the holes.
Screw the back on from underneath.
